notes: Primary source: the official laliga.com "Where to watch LALIGA 2026/27" pages, which embed the official broadcaster list per country (fetched for every country locale, e.g. https://www.laliga.com/en-XX/where-to-watch-laliga-easports; page data confirms season 2026). Spain 2026-27 is the final season of the 2022-27 domestic cycle: Movistar Plus+ and DAZN share the pay rights, DAZN also streams one match per matchday free, and LALIGA TV BAR serves hospitality venues. Free-to-air flags are based on the nature of each channel (public/terrestrial broadcasters, Wikipedia channel articles); FTA partners typically carry only selected matches. Channels marked "not verified" in notes are named by laliga.com but their access model could not be confirmed. Kosovo (XK) had no data on laliga.com. Liechtenstein, San Marino and Afghanistan come from the Wikipedia list only (unconfirmed for 2026-27). Web search quota was exhausted mid-research, so some secondary confirmations (e.g. African FTA partners, Brazil SportyNet) could not be cross-checked.
